## Release · 2026-11-06T11:14Z · claim 6683310108 · stopped on the premise, blocked on #30918

⛔ Not a claim.

- The card thread (`claude/project-thread-14ejvp`, no commits) measured live on `origin/main` `7d9682ffd7` and stopped as the claim required: the list has no server read to stand on. Reading: `/mnt/project-files/ui-seat-3/r2026-11-06/30894/reading-7d9682ff.md` (project files).
- Missing, filed to `domain:server` as #30918: a ledgered read of the person's authorized assistants (the three OAuth tables answer `OBJECT_API_DISABLED`; better-auth's `get-consents` has no `AUTH_ROUTE_LEDGER` row and no client method); any record of an assistant's last use (MCP access tokens are JWTs, `sys_oauth_access_token` held 0 rows after two MCP calls, so the body's premise on that table does not hold); a door for an administrator over a managed person (`get-consents` ignores `user_id`).
- API keys are readable today (own rows with `last_used_at`, revoke ends access), but the card's point is the assistants the consent page promises; the seat does not ship a keys-only list as this card.
- The Account half also needs a nav entry in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/account.app.ts` (named on #30918).
- This card's body now adds `Blocked-by: #30918` beside #30345; it moves to `pm:blocked`, assignee cleared. The worktree is kept; the ui seat that unblocks it re-reads the server answer first.
